subject: Compliance transition credit structure & amortization discussion
messages:
From: Lina Yang <lina.yang@wellbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearsight.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance transition credit structure — request for clarity

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo and the draft SOW. Before we route this to legal, procurement has two open questions we need clarified around how Redwood plans to account for the one-time implementation costs for HSM seats and the residency transition fee:

1) Amortization window: Are the HSM/ residency implementation charges billed up-front or amortized as a credit against monthly usage over a defined period? If amortized, what's the default term?

2) Credit triggers: Can credits be staged based on go-live milestones (pilot, full-prod, 90-day stability), and will there be clawback language if we terminate early?

Attached is a redline of the SOW with a placeholder for the credit schedule — see page 3. We prefer staged amortization to minimize cash outlay during the pilot. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Lina
Lina Yang
Head of Procurement 
WellBridge Health

Attachment: WellBridge_SOW_draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Yang <lina.yang@wellbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance transition credit structure — request for clarity

Lina — thanks for the clear note and the SOW redline. Appreciate the preference for staged amortization; that’s consistent with how we’ve done similar pilots. High level:

- We can offer an amortized credit for one-time implementation fees (HSM setup + residency transition) applied as recurring monthly credits against committed usage. Default amortization term is 12 months, but we can flex to 6 or 18 months depending on commitment level.
- Credits can be milestone-based: pilot (50% credit applied on first full-prod), full-prod (25% at full-prod), stability (25% at 90-day stability).
- Early termination: we include a pro-rata clawback where any un-credited portion accelerates to due amount; however, for committed contracts >= 12 months we can soften clawback with a capped refund schedule.

I’m looping in Ben (Enterprise Sales) and Tessa (RevOps) to propose a concrete schedule and to check how this maps to pricing/discount bands for your expected commit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance transition credit structure — request for clarity

Marking up an approach we can take to give WellBridge lower up-front cash flow risk while protecting Redwood economics. Initial proposal:

- Tiered amortization terms by commit band:
  * 6 months amortization for 36+ month committed ARR
  * 12 months amortization for 12–35 month committed ARR
  * 18 months amortization for <12 month pilots (pilot credits capped at 50% of implementation fee)
- Milestone schedule (firm):
  * Pilot completion: 40% of total credit applied once pilot meets acceptance criteria
  * Full production: additional 30% applied on first full-prod invoice
  * 90-day stability: remaining 30% applied
- Early termination / clawback: remaining unpaid credit becomes payable net 30; for deals >= 24 months we allow a 6-month forgiveness staircase (i.e., reduce clawback by 1/6 per month after month 6).

Tessa — can you pull the pricing workback and show the impact on ARR/NRR for each band? We should also recommend whether HSM seats are modeled as one-time capex (setup fee) vs. a recurring seat fee that’s eligible for credits.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance transition credit structure — request for clarity

Ben / Marissa — attached is a preliminary workback that models the amortization under the three commit bands and the impact to 12m ARR and cash collection parity. Highlights:

- Converting HSM setup to a recurring "HSM seat" (monthly) reduces short-term cash collection needs and aligns with our licensing cadence; makes credits simpler (apply as bill credit against monthly invoice).
- For pilots under 12 months, I recommend a 50% pilot credit cap and a required conversion trigger to any committed tier to unlock the remainder. This avoids fully subsidizing short pilots.
- I added a sample clause for DocuSign: staged credits applied as invoice offsets; customer liability for unearned credits upon termination (with schedule).

I can export an XLS workback to share with procurement — searching internal pricing for similar precedents now.

Tessa Morgan
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: compliance-credit-workback.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Yang <lina.yang@wellbridge.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance transition credit structure — request for clarity

Lina / Sam — looping back with a concrete offer based on our internal alignment. Attached is the clean SOW with the credit schedule baked in and a one-page summary of the amortization. Summary (proposal):

- Total implementation fee (HSM + residency cutover): $140,000 one-time
- Offer: Redwood provides a staged amortized credit equal to 100% of the implementation fee applied as monthly invoice credits over 12 months (default) if WellBridge commits to a 12-month minimum consumption commitment at the time of signature.
- Milestone application: 40% credit at pilot acceptance, 30% at full production, 30% at 90-day stability.
- For pilots <12 months or non-committed contracts, we will amortize over 18 months and cap pilot-credit at 50%; clawback applies pro-rata on termination.
- Alternate: If WellBridge prefers, we can convert HSM fees to a recurring seat (recommended), with credits applied as bill discounts to seats; sample pricing in appendix.

Next steps: Lina, if this matches the procurement appetite, I can submit the SOW for legal with the DocuSign link. If you want to discuss the forgiveness staircase for longer contracts (>=24 months), we can include that as an addendum.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: WellBridge_SOW_draft.pdf (clean SOW), compliance-credit-workback.xlsx (amortization scenarios)
